title: Finite log charts describe the open triviality locus and invertible restrictions
statement: Let $(X,M,\alpha)$ be a locally Noetherian fs log scheme [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, pqf-def-locnoeth], and let $V\subseteq X$ be its zero-characteristic locus. There exists an open $U\subseteq X$ whose underlying set is $V$. For every geometric point $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ [def-weil-geometric-point], affine etale neighbourhood $W\to X$ with a lift $w$ of $t$, cancellative additive commutative monoid $P$, chart $c:P\to M(W)$, and finite list $p:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to P$ generating $P$ additively, let $s_W=\prod_i\alpha(c(p_i))$ and $s=\prod_i a_{t,W,w,c}(p_i)$, where $a$ is the canonical chart map [def-trf-chart-strict-henselization-map]. Then $W\times_X U=D(s_W)$ as underlying subsets of $W$, and the inverse image of $U$ under the canonical strict-henselization structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map] is $D(s)\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{X,t}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Every log section on every etale test object restricts on its pullback over $U$ to an invertible regular function. Empty generating lists are allowed; their products are $1$. Neither a domain hypothesis nor contraction of monoid ideals is assumed.

proof.text: For any fine saturated log scheme, at any geometric point of $W$, the chart pushout in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] has zero characteristic exactly when all chart elements are units: if the characteristic is zero every log element differs from the identity by a unit; conversely if every chart element is a unit the pushout is just the group of ring units. A finite generating list reduces this to the $a_W(p_i)$. At a prime of the affine scheme $W$, an element is a unit in the geometric local ring exactly when its residue is nonzero: the germ maps are local, and extension of residue fields preserves being nonzero. All $a_W(p_i)$ have nonzero residue exactly when their product does. Consequently $V\times_XW=D(s_W)$. Pulling the defining section along the limit projection $\operatorname{Spec}A\to W$ sends $s_W$ to $s$, so its inverse image is $D(s)$. No domain, sharpness, characteristic identification, or ideal contraction is used. The empty generating list gives D(1).

proof.text: The finitely generated fs charts supplied by the fs condition, chosen at all geometric points, cover $X$ by their images. Each $W\to X$ is flat and locally of finite presentation by [def-weil-etale-morphism], hence open by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-lfp-open]. By the principal-open chart criterion in the preceding step the image of $D(s_W)$ is contained in $V$; every point of $V$ has a lift to one of these charts and that lift lies in $D(s_W)$. Thus $V$ is the union of these open images and is open.

proof.text: On $V$, zero characteristic means that every germ of $M$ differs from the identity by a ring unit. The log-structure axiom in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] identifies these unit germs with germs of $\mathcal O_V^\times$. Thus a section of $M$ over any etale open restricts on its inverse image of $V$ to a locally invertible function. The local inverses agree on overlaps, since an inverse is unique, and glue. Every such restricted section is a unit, as asserted.

theorem FineSaturatedLogScheme.finiteChart_trivialityLocus
    (X : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}) :
    ∃ U : X.scheme.Opens,
      (U : Set X.scheme) = X.logStructure.trivialityLocus ∧
      (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X.scheme)
        (P : Type u) [AddCancelCommMonoid P] (W : X.scheme.Etale)
        (w : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale t).fiber.obj W)
        (c : Multiplicative P →* X.logStructure.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op W)),
        IsAffine W.left → X.logStructure.IsChart W c →
        ∀ (r : ℕ) (p : Fin r → P), AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range p) = ⊤ →
          W.hom ⁻¹' (U : Set X.scheme) =
            (W.left.basicOpen (∏ i : Fin r,
              X.logStructure.alpha.app (op W) (c (Multiplicative.ofAdd (p i)))) :
                Set W.left) ∧
          Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap t ⁻¹' (U : Set X.scheme) =
            ((PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (∏ i : Fin r,
              X.logStructure.chartStrictHenselizationMap t W w c
                (Multiplicative.ofAdd (p i)))).carrier :
                Set (Spec (Scheme.strictHenselizationRing t)))) ∧
      ∀ (W : X.scheme.Etale) (m : X.logStructure.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op W)),
        IsUnit ((pullback.fst W.hom U.ι).appTop (X.logStructure.alpha.app (op W) m))
